citation: Menota AM-36-fol 369:14; wave-5 report 2, observation 0. The injured individual is resumed as Karl in the narrative. Kaikki s.v. karl is the common man noun; this referent is a personal name, not common-noun evidence.

Menota AM-63-fol 385:; wave-5 report 6, observation 0. Burial in Hallvarðskirkja beside the choir establishes kórr, chancel (Kaikki s.v. kórr). The reported folio 383 is inaccurate: the words are on 385, with two duplicated kor tokens in the XML; both have the same sense.

Menota HolmPerg-30-4to 78r:19; wave-5 report 8, observation 0. Source legal construction takes man as an accusative human object (outlawed man / maim a man / kill that man / deprive a man of a thief). Kaikki s.v. maðr distinguishes the noun from modal munu. Each selected occurrence was read in its own clause.

Menota HolmPerg-30-4to 84r:21; wave-5 report 18, observation 0. Source coordinates list severing a hand or foot; fott is the object paired with hond. Kaikki s.v. fótr: foot, from *pṓds, not fǿða.

Menota AM-35-fol 209:; wave-5 report 19, observation 0. The gods are the possessors of gengi as Hákon joins their company. Kaikki s.v. goð, neuter god; genitive plural goða, not adjective góðr. Repair only the reported h10 occurrence, not every goða.

Menota HolmPerg-34-4to-MLB 90r:7; wave-5 report 29, observation 0. Coordinated duties of rowing, bailing and covering a ship establish the action noun. Zoega s.v. austr distinguishes masculine bailing from neuter east: https://norse.ulver.com/dct/zoega/a.html.

Menota HolmPerg-30-4to 80v:12; wave-5 report 30, observation 0. Both source participles refer to the lending of a horse or ship and its permitted duration. Kaikki s.v. ljá, lend < *līhwaną; not léttr, light. The second occurrence is actually on line 15.

Menota HolmPerg-30-4to 80v:15; wave-5 report 30, observation 1. Both source participles refer to the lending of a horse or ship and its permitted duration. Kaikki s.v. ljá, lend < *līhwaną; not léttr, light. The second occurrence is actually on line 15.

Menota AM-36-fol 467:29; wave-5 report 35, observation 0. The source has looking west from a mountain; veítt modifies the seeing verb as a spatial adverb. Kaikki s.v. víðr, wide; neuter adverb vítt, not veita.

Menota HolmPerg-34-4to-MLL 26v:8; wave-5 report 44, observation 0. The three separately checked sources concern a slain man, killing for inheritance, and Sigurðr killing the serpent respectively. Kaikki s.v. vega separates *wiganą fight/slay < *weyk- from *weganą transport < *weǵʰ-.

Menota HolmPerg-34-4to-MLL 15v:20; wave-5 report 53, observation 0. Both source noun occurrences coordinate understanding with skynsemð. Kaikki s.v. vit separates neuter understanding < *witą from the dual pronoun; use the already reviewed vit@understanding sense at these new coordinates.

Menota HolmPerg-4-fol 2-081:8; wave-5 report 73, observation 0. The source describes raising a fist or striking with it, respectively. Zoega s.v. hnefi, fist, https://norroen.info/dct/zoega/h.html. The h-less forms are not nefi nephew. Existing hnefi table also wrongly falls back to nefi, so block that false mapping explicitly.

Menota HolmPerg-4-fol 2-087:20; wave-5 report 74, observation 0. Source embassy to request a daughter’s hand requires journey genitive farar. Kaikki s.v. fǫr < *farō; use reviewed fǫr@journey, not the for/pig collision.

Menota HolmPerg-4-fol 2-147:21; wave-5 report 75, observation 0. Source nominal hair is compared with beaten gold and followed by beard description; XML NC annotation agrees. Kaikki s.v. hár noun < *hērą differs from adjective high < *hauhaz. Apply existing hár@hair sense locally.

Menota HolmPerg-4-fol 2-060:2; wave-5 report 76, observation 0. Plural daughters are the subject and the following infinitive expresses what they cannot do. Kaikki s.v. kunna, know/be able; kunu is verbal, not kona woman.

Menota HolmPerg-4-fol 102r:7; wave-5 report 90, observation 0. Source command to listen and stand still is followed by silence before the king speaks. Kaikki s.v. hljóð lists silence/hearing < *hleuþą < *ḱlew-. Repair lióð to hljóð and use the hearing root rather than the existing incline-linked pseudo-lexeme.

Menota Lbs-fragm-82 1r:13; wave-5 report 94, observation 0. Source hrafn is the subject of the negated hunger predicate amid wolf-food imagery. Zoega s.v. svelta gives preterite svalt, https://norse.ulver.com/dct/zoega/s.html; svalta contains the negative suffix -a (Zoega s.v. a), not svala.

Menota HolmPerg-4-fol 113r:17; wave-5 report 96, observation 0. Source comparative adjective retains hræði- and is coordinated with mæiri in the dragon description. Zoega s.v. hræði-ligr, dreadful, https://norroen.info/dct/zoega/h.html; correct the dropped initial h in ræðiligr.

Menota Lbs-fragm-82 1v:28; wave-5 report 100, observation 0. The source places the king’s hands on Egill’s painful side. Actual location is Lbs-fragm-82 1v:28, not reported 1r:22. Kaikki s.v. síða noun < *sīdǭ and Proto-Germanic sīdǭ < *sīdaz distinguish side from the magic verb. Isolate noun sense; no new deep PIE equation asserted.

Menota Wolf-Aug-9-10-4to 49v:30; wave-5 report 109, observation 0. The praise object is vísi ruler; actual location is Wolf-Aug-9-10-4to 49v:30, not 33v:8. Kaikki s.v. vísi derives the ruler noun from vísa direct. Correct lemma/POS to existing vísi@ruler but retain its *weyd- root; the report’s inference that the root must disappear is not adopted.
